name: it-asset-management
description: IT Asset Management System — monorepo (Next.js web, NestJS API, shared types)

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @itam/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @itam/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @itam/shared && npm run build -w @itam/api && npm run build -w @itam/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @itam/api && npm run test:e2e -w @itam/api && npm run test -w @itam/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @itam/shared && npm run typecheck -w @itam/api && npm run typecheck -w @itam/web
